label: Input Row
purpose: A row of up to two form input fields, used inside the Contact Form section
_notes: Corrects a stale pre-Phase-11 schema (blocks/input_row.json, id "input_row") that didn't match any real Shopify block type or setting shape — the real Liquid block (referenced by sections/contact-form.liquid as "field_row") is a row of up to two inputs, each independently enabled/typed/required, not a single generic field. input_2_custom_name only applies when the corresponding *_type is "custom".
